S.FORM: kawas tay 1934, ryax sa tay 26 nqu tay 3, Alan Arkin, squliq na Bunge'. pinqbaqan nya Alan Arkin, t'aring kawas tay 1951 tehuk kawas tay 1953, mqwas biru sa Los Angeles City pqwsan biru krahu. Alan Arkin uzi mqwas biru sa Bennington pqwsan biru krahu. qnxan nya Alan Arkin maki tay kawas 1955 msqun ki Jeremy Yaffe, maki tay kawas 1961 t'alax. maki 2 la'iy, Adam Arkin (1956-), Matthew Arkin (1960-). Alan Arkin maki tay kawas 1964 msqun ki Barbara Dana, maki tay kawas 1994 t'alax. maki 1 la'iy, Anthony Dana Arkin. Alan Arkin maki tay kawas 1996 msqun ki Suzanne Newlander, tehuk misuw qani. mintzyuwaw nya Alan Arkin hiya ga m'engi. t'aring sa kawas 1960, mtzyuwaw zyuwaw na engi ru mqwas.
